Canopy redistributes the unmodified es5/tex-svg.js and the color and physics
TeX components from the MathJax 3.2.2 distribution. Component files were
renamed to mathjax-color.js and mathjax-physics.js without changing bytes.
The full Apache License 2.0 is in LICENSE-mathjax.txt. The copyright above
is retained from the corresponding MathJax-src 3.2.2 source headers.
Upstream MathJax 3.2.2 has no top-level NOTICE file. This redistribution note
was added by canopy; it does not change the upstream license.
